answer_1.quote: Text summarization systems have been developed rapidly due to the appearance of sequence-to-sequence frameworks, transformer architectures and large-scale pre-training models.

answer_2.quote: Thus, it is necessary to develop automatic evaluation metrics for text summarization systems.

answer_4.quote: For TAC datasets, we compute correlation coefficients between predicted scores of an evaluation method and the annotated Pyramid scores of summaries to measure the effectiveness of the method.
answer_4.guideline: The annotated Pyramid scores of summaries are used as human ratings to compute correlation with predicted scores.
